name: OpenDisplay tag (via Home Assistant)
description: An OpenDisplay BLE e-paper tag driven through Home Assistant. Tesserae renders a full-colour PNG, writes it into HA's media folder, and calls the opendisplay.upload_image action; HA's OpenDisplay integration pushes it to the tag over Bluetooth LE and dithers for the panel. No separate bridge or BLE hardware on the Tesserae host. Set the tag's HA device id below. Best when Tesserae runs as the Home Assistant add-on (shared /media). Requires the Home Assistant Core plugin.

ha_device_id.label: HA device id
ha_device_id.help: Home Assistant's internal device id for the tag: a long hex string (e.g. 4ab9c7f0e2…), NOT the tag's own name/serial (e.g. OD6CD5F9). Find it in Developer Tools → Actions → opendisplay.upload_image: pick the tag in the device picker, switch to YAML mode, and copy the device_id value. Tesserae targets this device when it pushes.

rotate.label: Rotation
rotate.help: Rotation applied by the HA upload action, if the tag's mounting needs it.
